auth: 1. Tenant signs a Carro retailer (buyer) contract (custom pricing, demo)
2. In Settings › Dropshipping › Integrations the tenant generates an API key
3. Every call sends `Authorization: <key>`; buyer keys reach the Buyer + Shared endpoint groups
4. Optional: register webhook configurations for order / fulfilment events

reference.limits: 5 requests per second per key (`X-Rate-Limit-Limit: 5`, `X-Rate-Limit-Duration: 1`), HTTP 429 above; `X-Request-ID` on every response for support. - Retailer account is contract / demo gated (custom pricing) — no self-serve signup - API ordering is the intended integration path (EDI / SFTP / CSV are the alternatives listed) - Supplier brands are paid when the retailer's customer buys; the retailer is the seller of record

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Modern Dropship (Carro) API key generated under Settings > Dropshipping > Integrations, sent raw as `Authorization: <key>` (securityScheme ApiKeyAuth, no Bearer prefix). A buyer (retailer) key reaches the Buyer + Shared endpoints used here.

me.note: GET /auth/me returns {data: {user, company, flags, subscriptions}} for the key's user and company.

list_products.note: GET /buyer/products lists the products the buyer has access to ({data: [{id, title, brand, description, images[{source}], variants[{id, sku, basePrice, baseCurrency, retailPrice, inventoryAmount}]}], hasMore}); `page` is 0-based, `query` is the case-insensitive `title` substring filter and `category` is passed as `companyId` (a seller company id from GET /partners). Price/sku/stock are taken from the first variant.

get_product.note: GET /buyer/products/{product_id} -> {data: product}; all variants [{id, sku, basePrice, baseCurrency, retailPrice, inventoryAmount, options}] are in `raw.variants` (variant ids are what an order needs).

get_order.note: GET /buyer/orders/{order_id} -> {data: {id, buyerReference, created, items[], sellerOrders[{id, posted, fulfilled, fulfillments[{carrier, trackingCode, trackingUrls}]}]}}. There is no single order status or total: per-seller `posted`/`fulfilled` flags are in `raw.sellerOrders`.

not_offered.create_order: POST /buyer/orders requires `buyerReference` ('A reference to an ID in your (the buyer's) system. The ID must be unique.') and `orderedDate`, items[{variantId, quantity, buyerReference}] and shippingMethods[{code, title, price{amount, currency}}]; the vocabulary carries no order reference and its `shipping_option` string cannot be shaped into that array, so the body cannot be built without inventing values.
not_offered.quote_shipping: No rate-quote endpoint: GET /shipping/methods lists the company's own configured shipping methods (page/limit) and takes no product or destination.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; sellerOrders[].fulfillments[{carrier, trackingCode, trackingUrls}] are part of GET /buyer/orders/{order_id} (see get_order).

evidence: host api.moderndropship.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
